disease_label_per_paper: Acute conversion to acute myeloid leukemia with hyperleukocytosis, leukostasis, DIC-like coagulopathy, and multiple organ failure
presentation_summary: 71-year-old man with known MDS suddenly collapsed while traveling, with clouded consciousness, bilateral pupil dilation, unstable respiration, cardiac arrests, and large subcutaneous bleeding after a fall.

Laboratory evaluation showed WBC 468.48 x10^9/L with 89% blasts, hemoglobin 7.8 g/dL, severe coagulopathy with INR 2.4, aPTT 55.1 s, fibrinogen 117 mg/dL, D-dimer 274.1, LDH 6804 U/L, creatinine 2.73 mg/dL, CRP 15.91 mg/dL, and severe metabolic acidosis/hypoxemia.
The article diagnosed hyperleukocytosis and leukostasis associated with acute conversion to AML, probably M4, and described DIC-like bleeding/thrombotic pressure and multiple organ failure.
